title: TLCTC Attack Path Instance (Dynamic) — Schema
description: Validates TLCTC incident/attack-path instances for exchange and documentation.

framework_ref.description: Identifier/filename for the framework definition package used for interpretation.

registry_ref.description: Identifier/filename for the local reference registry used (spheres/contexts).

path_sequence.description: Ordered list of sequence items. Each item is a single attack_step, a parallel_group, or (V2.1) an unresolved_step representing forensic uncertainty where a step is known to exist but cannot yet be classified.

step_id.description: Identifier for steps/groups within this document (document-unique).

sphere_id.description: Responsibility sphere identifier. Use '@...' when known, or '?' when unknown.

delta_t.description: Time to next item (Attack Velocity Δt). Supports unknown '?', estimated '~15m', and bounded '<=5m' forms.

boundary.description: Boundary annotation equivalent to ||[context][@Source→@Target]||. For transit boundaries, use transit_spheres to record intermediate carrier spheres: @Attacker⇒@Carrier→@Target.

transit_spheres.description: Ordered list of intermediate carrier spheres through which the attack transits before reaching the target. The source_sphere originates, each transit_sphere relays, and the target_sphere receives.

intra_system_boundary.description: Intra-system boundary crossing within a single host or system. Notated as |[type][@from→@to]|.

intra_system_boundaries.description: Intra-system boundary crossings within a single host (e.g., sandbox escape, privilege escalation).

fec_executed.description: Analyst assertion: an FEC execution occurred and MUST be recorded as a #7 step (here or via fec_recorded_in_step_id).

fec_recorded_in_step_id.description: If fec_executed=true and this step is not #7/TLCTC-07.xx, reference the step_id of the #7 step that records the execution moment.

outcomes.description: Data Risk Events (DRE) tags resulting from this step (effects; do not change classification). Refinement tree per framework data_risk_events: C=Confidentiality; I=Integrity with Ii=incorrect state (correspondence/completeness fails) and If=misattributed state (provenance/attribution fails); A=Availability/Accessibility with Av=unavailable (data gone/unreachable) and Ac=inaccessible (data present but unusable). A parent code (I, A) stays legal when the refinement is unknown.

evidence_refs.description: Optional references (tickets, log sources, intel reports, indicator IDs).

intra_system_boundaries.description: Intra-system boundary crossings within a single host (e.g., sandbox escape, privilege escalation).

steps.description: Steps executed in parallel. Member steps MUST NOT carry delta_t_to_next; use the group's delta_t_to_next. Members may be classified attack steps or (V2.1) unresolved steps.

unresolved_step.description: V2.1 Unresolved-Step (see whitepaper §11.5.4). Represents a step that is known to exist but cannot yet be classified. Maps to the '?' (single) or '…' (gap) textual operators. Governed by R-UNRES-1 through R-UNRES-9. MUST NOT carry 'cluster' (R-UNRES-2). MUST NOT carry 'outcomes' (R-UNRES-5) — DRE tags are only valid on classified steps. 'notes' is REQUIRED and MUST explain what is unresolved per R-UNRES-8. 'candidates' is INFORMATIONAL ONLY — if any candidate can be individually defended on the evidence, record the step as a classified attack_step with [conf=low] instead (R-UNRES-9, binary classification).

unresolved_type.description: 'single' maps to the '?' operator (exactly one unresolved step). 'gap' maps to the '…' operator (one or more unresolved steps).

estimated_count.description: Optional count or range estimate for 'gap' type (e.g., '2-4'). Informational only; does not constitute classification.

candidates.description: Cluster IDs under consideration. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — does not constitute classification (R-UNRES-9).

intra_system_boundaries.description: Intra-system boundary crossings. Permitted on unresolved steps per R-UNRES-6 (boundaries are independently observable and do not depend on cluster classification).

evidence_refs.description: Optional references (tickets, log sources, intel reports, indicator IDs).

notes.description: REQUIRED prose annotation per R-UNRES-8 explaining (1) what evidence indicates a step exists, (2) what evidence is missing or ambiguous, (3) candidate hypotheses if any.

unresolved_step_in_parallel.description: V2.1 Unresolved-Step variant for use inside a parallel_group. Same semantics as unresolved_step, but without delta_t_to_next (transition time belongs to the group). See unresolved_step for R-UNRES-* constraints.

sequence_item.description: A single attack step, a parallel group, or (V2.1) an unresolved step representing forensic uncertainty.
